# Healthcare Patient Representatives

This folder catalogs individuals who act as patient representatives within healthcare governance and clinical quality improvement initiatives. It documents advocates who sit on steering committees to ensure that patient perspectives and user involvement are actively integrated into the development of clinical quality indicators and treatment standards. Currently, it covers representatives involved with the Acute Surgery Database, highlighting their role in addressing systemic barriers to quality measurement and regional variations in acute surgical care.

## Pages

- [[vera-slyk|Vera Slyk]] — Patient representative on the Steering Committee for the Acute Surgery Database, advocating for the integration of patient perspectives into clinical quality indicators and treatment standards.
